notes: Build71 adds the Universal Agent Runtime Registry behind the Decrypter trust boundary. Five initial adapters are normalized: decrypter-local, OpenHands Agent Server, Codex CLI, OpenCode and Aider. HTTP/loopback runtimes can be probed from the MV3 extension when host permission is granted; CLI, stdio, ACP and Codex App Server transports are explicitly bridge-required because a browser extension cannot spawn arbitrary local processes. Runtime credentials/endpoints are session-only and never enter durable settings or prompts. Prompt transport prefers stdin or prompt files, rejects oversized argv payloads and Windows .cmd/.bat environment-expansion hazards, and always declares shell=false. Runtime events are normalized without raw reasoning payloads. Every external runtime is proposal-only: writeAuthority=false and final mutation remains behind Decrypter approval, Scope Intelligence v2, Human Intent, Tool Runtime, Continuity and Guarded Commit. Cumulative guarantees remain explicit: Build65 Scope Intelligence v2 + Human Intent with USER_EDIT > AI_EDIT; Build66 Smart Undo/Redo with three-way preservation and one-shot confirmations; Build67 Continuity Engine; Build68 Local Agent Orchestrator + Model Router with exact proposal digest binding and zero paid/remote fallback; Build69 DecrypterBench v2 / Hardening with repository path traversal defenses; Build70 mandatory Account Integration Gate with GitHub App + Supabase OAuth; Context Engine v2; MCP 2026-07-28 Trust Gateway; Guarded Commit. No OTA metadata, GitHub Release or store publication is authorized.
